STAMP REFRESHED AFTER THE 2026-09-04 REBASE, NUMBER UNCHANGED. 19.0-marin was replayed onto origin, so every SHA changed and the stamps written hours earlier were orphaned again -- the same mechanism, and the flag working. Re-measured at b67fa612706 in a clean detached worktree, and it reads what the floor already said. Scope trap worth recording, because I hit it: run from the REPO ROOT, where 'odoo/' means the core package and the lint roots are 'odoo addons'; run one level up and ruff reports 3,117 findings from the bundled addons against a hard-zero floor.
